shortDescription: According to Bloomberg, Xie Jun, a deputy general manager at China National Petroleum Corp. (CNPC), is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, the country's top anti-graft authority said in a statement on Sunday.

title: China Probes CNPC Deputy General Manager Xie Jun for Suspected Corruption
